entries.bad_example: # Just run the whole script and check output
entries.rationale: SS QLM treats Shell as a first-class language. Unit testing individual functions by sourcing the script is mandatory for CI/CD confidence.

entries.good_example:
df() { echo "/dev/sda1 100% 100% 0% /mnt"; }
# Now test how the script handles 100% full disk
entries.rationale: Tests should not depend on hardware or environment state. SS QLM encourages 'Shadow Function Mocking' to simulate failures (disk full, network down, etc.).
